message: Short plain-language statement intended to be mirrored verbatim.
details_markdown: Optional longer text. Keep it concise. Prefer bullets and include reproducibility hooks (hashes, packet pointers), not screenshots.

notes: If this is a correction: set notice_type=correction and set correction_of_notice_id to the notice_id being corrected. If this is a follow-up update: set notice_type=status_update and set supersedes_notice_id to the prior notice_id. Use next_update_at for a measurable update commitment when applicable.
